professional_domain.name: GitHub repository radar noise-polish and evidence-backed action planning
responsibilities: Keep SKILL.md focused on trigger, input, workflow, output, and completion instructions.
Keep evaluation-rubric.md focused on scoring, downgrade, red-flag, action-state, and counter-challenge rules.
Preserve evidence-backed action states while removing subjective wording and audit vocabulary from user-facing content.
non_goals: No new schema, template, script, hook, or live GitHub crawler.
No final legal, security, or production adoption approval.
No cleanup of historical skill-refiner dogfood or evidence artifacts.
professional_domain.success_boundary: A completed polish keeps github-repo-radar behavior intact while active Skill/reference content contains only precise instructions, judging rules, output requirements, routing rules, and failure conditions.

practice_flow: Confirm the noise-polish baseline and responsibility split.
Review Trigger through Runtime one ring at a time.
Freeze the final PATCH scope at SR-F1.
Run contract-test RED, patch active content, then prove GREEN.

optimization_goal.objective: Noise-polish github-repo-radar so active Skill and reference content use precise repository-radar instructions and judging rules without audit vocabulary leakage.
success_standards: SKILL.md keeps trigger, input, workflow, output, action states, routing, and completion checks while removing subjective and audit-language noise.
evaluation-rubric.md stays focused on scoring, red flags, action-state rules, counter-challenges, evidence, and downgrade rules.
The contract test proves evidence obligations, no unconsumed runtime artifacts, no user-facing audit vocabulary, eval coverage, adapter alignment, and run-all registration.
Runtime structure and adapter wording remain unchanged unless validation proves drift.
exclusions: No adapter rewrite or runtime/install structure change.
No eval expansion beyond existing seven scenarios.
No cleanup of historical skill-refiner dogfood/evidence artifacts.
